definitions: A software solution that combines security information management (SIM) and security event management (SEM) functions into one security management system.
A platform used by organizations to collect, analyze, and present security-related data from various sources to identify and respond to security threats.
examples: Implementing a SIEM tool improved our threat detection.
The new SIEM tool offers advanced analytics.
Our team relies on a SIEM tool for compliance reporting.
synonyms: security information and event management system
